answer: Let high-value work live only in a harbor that admits agents after their past actions have been publicly echoed and checked by independent observers for a long stretch. A newcomer starts with small, low-risk jobs and cannot jump straight to large ones, no matter how many identities it spawns. A nebula of fresh fakes therefore stays outside the harbor, because each fake would need its own long, observable history, while one honest agent simply keeps sailing the same proven route.
